directives.title: Dedicated Night Breakdown Helper & Staffing Protocol
points: At high-utilization sites like JK Paper, a dedicated night breakdown helper will be deployed so day technicians get mandatory rest and night breakdowns are resolved immediately without waking day crew.

directives.title: Emergency Night Breakdown Overtime (OT) Policy
points: Field technicians performing emergency night repairs will receive 2 hours of OT compensation for every 1 hour worked at night.
All OT claims must be supported by official client security gate punch in/out timestamp records.

directives.title: Mandatory Battery Cell Load Testing & Warranty Claims
points: For all 2024 JCB/Genie scissor lift batteries shutting off at 40–50% charge, field teams must test and record individual cell voltages under active load, take photos of battery manufacturing tags, and submit full service reports for OEM warranty claims.

directives.title: Mandatory App-Based Breakdown & Media Registration
points: Every machine breakdown (including Silvassa, Sanand, Noida) must be registered in the company mobile app with video/photos before requesting spare parts or technician mobilization.

directives.title: Strict Pre-Loading Service Report Requirement
points: No machine (e.g. Hyderabad, Sanand handovers) may be loaded or handed over to clients/vendors without a completed, signed service report and pre-dispatch inspection photos.
